cohort: 150 neonates from the Dermatology Outpatient Department, Obstetrics and Gynecology ward, and Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU)
finding: The most common cutaneous manifestations found were Mongolian spots (22%), physiological desquamation (18%), erythema toxicum neonatorum (12%), and acrocyanosis (8%).
birth_weight: Mentioned as a factor influencing the presence of milia
